a1.cap: Only signed-in users may open /account. Write a functional route guard that lets authenticated users through and redirects everyone else to /login?returnUrl=....

lines: Only signed-in users may open /account. Write a functional route guard that lets authenticated users through and redirects everyone else to /login?returnUrl=....

a1.cap: Guards are plain functions in modern Angular. inject() works inside them, so the guard can read the auth state and return either true or a UrlTree that redirects, which is safer than calling navigate inside a guard.
